versions.changelog:
Initial release of error-message-improver — a skill to help deliver clearer, actionable error messages for users and support teams.

- Provides structured workflows for improving error message clarity and helping users troubleshoot effectively.
- Delivers tailored responses, reusable checklists, and validation notes for improved support and user feedback.
- Focuses on local-hardware friendly solutions, preferring scripts and templates to cloud-only or resource-heavy approaches.
- Includes triggers for productivity, debugging, support, and error message–related requests.
